name: schema_version
description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking change.

name: sample_tier
description: How the stream entered the sample: top (viewer floor applies) | watchlist (no floor)

name: observed_at
description: Time the API response was received, UTC

name: run_id
description: Cloud Run execution name, or local-<timestamp> for local runs

name: platform_game_id
description: Game id in the platform's own id space (Twitch game_id, Kick category id)

name: platform_game_name
description: Game name as reported by the platform at sampling time

name: channel_id
description: Stable channel id (Twitch user_id, Kick broadcaster_user_id)

name: channel_login
description: Channel login or slug at sampling time

name: stream_id
description: Platform stream id; Twitch only, Kick has none

name: stream_started_at
description: Stream start time reported by the platform, UTC

name: language
description: Stream language code as reported by the platform
